model.title: A resolution recognizing the 25th anniversary of the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, honoring the memory of the victims, recognizing the courage and sacrifice of the heroes who answered the call to serve, acknowledging the charitable organizations that continue to support survivors and victims' families, and reaffirming the enduring commitment of the United States to never forget.

summary.text: The resolution would commemorate the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks by honoring the victims and recognizing the bravery of first responders and others who served. It also aims to acknowledge charitable organizations supporting survivors and victims' families while reaffirming the nation's commitment to remembering the attacks.
